name: Jem
look: A lanky young man in his twenties with straw in his hair, a sleepy face, a loose undyed shirt and patched trousers held up with string.
personality: Lazy, good-natured and full of excuses; works hard only when Ada is looking.
values: naps, an easy life, his dinner
concerns: Staying out of Ada's sight; he was meant to water the mule.

pail.text: Ada's pail hangs by the mill door.
pail.line: Pail's by the door. If you're doing the trough. Which I was going to.
pail.lead: Ada's pail is by the mill door.

persuaded_by: not having to do it himself

samples: I was just resting my eyes.
The trough? Yeah. I was going to.
voice.habits: Yawns; makes excuses; asks you not to tell Ada.

superstition.text: Jem would want to know how it works.
